1.translation: About what are they asking one another?

3.footnotes: [2] The pagans of Makkah denied the Qur’an, resurrection, and judgment. They differed as to whether the Qur’an was magic, fortune-telling, or poetry.

4.translation: No indeed; they will come to know.

5.translation: Again no; they will come to know.

6.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

7.footnotes: [3] Mountains go deep below the surface like pegs and icebergs, stabilizing the earth and slowing tectonic movement.

9.translation: and made your sleep for rest,

10.translation: and made the night a covering[4],
10.footnotes: [4] Covering you in its darkness as garments cover you.

11.translation: and made the day for seeking a livelihood,

12.translation: and built above you seven mighty heavens,

13.translation: and made therein a blazing lamp,

14.translation: and sent down from the rainclouds abundant water,

15.translation: so that We may produce thereby grains and vegetation,

17.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgment is a time appointed,

18.translation: the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, you will come forth in crowds,

19.translation: and the sky will be opened up and will become gateways,

20.translation: and the mountains will vanish, becoming like a mirage.

21.translation: Indeed, Hell is lying in wait,

23.translation: wherein they will abide for endless ages.

24.translation: They will neither taste therein any coolness nor any drink,

25.translation: except for scalding water and discharge of wounds,

26.footnotes: [5] To their disbelief and evil deeds.

27.translation: Indeed, they did not expect a reckoning,

29.translation: But We have enumerated everything in a record[6].

30.translation: So taste [the punishment], for We will not increase you except in torment[7].”
30.footnotes: [7] The addressees are the dwellers of Hell.

31.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation[8],
31.footnotes: [8] i.e., safety from Hell and winning Paradise.

33.translation: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,

34.footnotes: [9] i.e., tasteful wine which neither intoxicates nor causes headache.

35.translation: They will not hear therein vain talk or lies –

36.translation: a reward and a generous gift from your Lord[10],
36.footnotes: [10] Or "a gift adequately calculated"; as a result of their righteous deeds as well as the ample generosity of Allah.

37.translation: [from] the Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the Most Compassionate; none will dare to speak to Him[11].
37.footnotes: [11] None can ask or plead on the Day of Judgment except by Allah's permission.

38.translation: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows; none will dare to speak, except those to whom the Most Compassionate granted permission, and they will only speak the truth.

39.translation: That Day is sure to come. So whoever wills may seek a path leading to his Lord[12].
39.footnotes: [12] i.e., the path of guidance and righteous deeds.

40.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment on the Day when everyone will see what his hands have sent forth[13], and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”
40.footnotes: [13] i.e., the deeds he did in this world.
